_help.delay_seconds: Wait between unfollows. Randomised by jitter_percent.
_help.jitter_percent: How much to randomise waits, in percent (30 means 7 to 13 s for a 10 s wait).
_help.daily_limit: Max unfollows per day. Instagram doesn't publish its limits, so keep this modest.
_help.browse_feed_during_breaks: Scroll your home feed during breaks, like a person would.
_help.verify_after_each_batch: After each batch, reopen the last profile to check Instagram really kept the unfollow.
_help.my_username: Your Instagram username. Leave empty, the bot finds it by itself.
